scope: VOICED sustained vowel /a/ pilot; pathological vs healthy voice, not diagnosis

training_data_provenance.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License v1.0
training_data_provenance.citation: Cesari et al. A new database of healthy and pathological voices. Computers & Electrical Engineering 68, 310-321, 2018. doi:10.1016/j.compeleceng.2018.04.008
training_data_provenance.scenario: Human sustained vowel recordings: healthy and pathological voices with source diagnoses
limitations: Not consultation speech; unsuitable for transcription or critical terms
Pathological voice label is not a fatigue, dyspnea or dysarthria diagnosis
Small convenience subset; no clinical performance claim
WFDB amplitudes converted to PCM16 without per-recording normalization

method: Logistic regression; development-only standardization; fixed threshold
